note: The declared T75 qualification matrix. Human-authored and reviewed; the signed evidence index is generated from it plus live fleet evidence at qualification time. Every dimension issue #16 names appears here, and every case carries an explicit status - an index that lists only what passed would report a green fleet by omission, which is the failure mode the whole matrix exists to prevent.

statuses.qualified: Exercised and passing, with evidence cited.
statuses.contract-qualified: The contract is exercised against fixtures; no live instance was qualified. Honest and bounded, not a pass for the live thing.
statuses.not-qualified: In scope and not qualified. Says so.
statuses.environmental: Not qualified for a reason outside the product. Never counted as a pass.

cases.evidence: The macos-15-intel runner passed all five exact-head gate profiles at the T75 candidate; its platform, architecture, runtime, candidate revision, and leg digest are bound in the committed fleet indexes.

dimensions.note: No single profile runs every stage, so the fleet must be dispatched four times to cover all sixteen. matrix.md section 2.
